findings.finding: The new project criterion's id is never named in the plan. The Scope section says 'a new `project.*` criterion' and AC5 says 'a project-only criterion + coaching move exists' but the plan never defines the criterion's actual id string (e.g. `project.symbol-reference-completeness`). Because `active_triggers` in plan-review Pass-4 is built from the `criteria` field of surviving findings — and `move_applies()` intersects `applies_when` against those triggers — the `applies_when` value for the new coaching move is impossible to specify correctly without knowing the criterion id. An executor must invent an id not defined in the plan, making the `applies_when` field for the new move undefined by the plan.
scenarios: An executor writes a move with `applies_when: ['project.serena-tool-preference']` while the criterion is registered as `project.symbol-reference-completeness` — the move is a permanently dead move that never fires.
An executor omits `applies_when` entirely — the move becomes always-applicable (fires on every review regardless of whether the criterion triggered), defeating the scoping intent stated in AC5.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a single sentence to Scope or AC5: 'The new criterion id is `project.symbol-reference-completeness`; the coaching move in `.rebar/plan_review_moves.json` carries `"applies_when": ["project.symbol-reference-completeness"]` so it fires only when that criterion has surviving findings.'
